sources.description: The chief-engineer at Omegaton Industries, Gainax Gray, was put in charge of the group assigned to improve the standard amplifiers for the imperial forces special ranger assault teams. The development group had to adapt and equip a standard model with new improved components to create a version with enhanced energy transformers. Although successful the new improved version was rejected by the imperial forces for still being inadequate to their needs. Instead the manufactured units of this special series were shipped to Calypso and sold off on the open market to whoever could afford them, making this quite a rare amplifier.

The number of different pieces of equipment that appear with their signature on it show a wide area of expertise, which strongly suggests that there must be more than just one member of the Illuminox present on Calypso

It´s made to be a generic attachment to any kind of energy weapon. This sight will increase the shooters chance of hitting targets.
